protocol: five object-disjoint Lighting test folds, three seeds, 50 diffusion steps
generated_object: one LFVD-Identity family code per family and seed
adjacent_reader: piecewise linear interpolation between the two neighboring generated VAE-latent segments
learned_reader: the trained scalar-conditioned LFVD query decoder applied to the identical sampled family code
metric_frames: generated RGB frames 1..16; conditioning frame 0 excluded
